raw: “On weekdays I have breakfast at the kitchen counter. I have rye bread, toasted on one side, and black tea in a green mug. The bread is toasted on just the one side, not both. When I picture the morning, it’s mostly that bit I remember—the counter, the toast, the green mug. That gets me thinking about work, too. I’m a supply clerk at an aquarium shop, so my mind can go from breakfast to the shop. But breakfast at the counter is the clearest part of the routine to describe.”
